lessons: Veto Double Chance '12' (lay-the-draw) bets whenever the market family or Matchbook record is LOSING.
Back 'Team or Draw' (1X/X2) over '12' Double Chance: 'Team or Draw' provides a safer barrier against draws.
Do not veto Asian Handicap +1.5 or +2.5 selections on small model-to-breakeven deficits (<3%): positive handicap cushions perform strongly.
Veto 'Win to Nil — no' at odds <=1.24 when the framework record is LOSING.
Veto Under 3.5 totals in lower league/cup fixtures; reserve Under backing for high cushions (Under 4.5 and Under 5.5).
Strictly veto Over 1.5 goals at short odds (1.20–1.28) when the framework record is LOSING.
Veto Double Chance '12' matches when missing player value exceeds 20% for either side to avoid unexpected draws.
Avoid Double Chance '12' at odds above 1.30: higher-priced lines carry unbacked volatility.
Veto Over 0.5 goals bets when the AI chance is below break-even and the framework record is LOSING.
football.summary: Refined the Over 1.5 goals odds ceiling rule to encompass odds up to 1.28 based on recent correct vetoes.

lessons: When backing 1st half NBA totals with model probabilities above 0.60, require odds of 1.90 or higher to maintain positive expected value.
